title: 🍉 AI Topic Summary
notTopic:
Open a topic first
to use the AI summary
notTopicHint: Refreshes automatically once you open a topic
infoFailed: ❌ Failed to load topic info. Refresh the page and retry.
rangeHintSegmented: {count} posts on the site; long topics are summarized in segments
needConfig: ⚠️ Configure the API in Settings first
invalidRange: Enter a valid integer floor range
noVisiblePosts: No posts in the selected range are visible to this account
partialPrefix: > Partial summary — final pass not completed
digestsPrefix: > Completed segment digests — final pass not completed
doneProgress: Summary complete · floors {start}–{end}, {count} posts read; expand to ask follow-ups
keepPartialSuffix: ; partial results kept — copy or retry
truncated: Output hit the length limit; received content was kept. Raise the output limit and retry.

settings.security: Data safety · Configuration stays in your script manager; summaries and follow-ups are sent only to the AI endpoint you configure, and the API key is used only for that service
settings.urlHintPrefix: Full endpoint, root URL or /v1 are accepted; plain HTTP is preserved for local services.
settings.modelHint: Use a model ID that actually exists on the service; leave the key empty when the service needs none.
settings.bufferedLabel: Compatibility mode: show the result at once (no streaming)
settings.localHint: If a LAN service cannot be reached, check its bind address, firewall, Tampermonkey target-host permissions and browser local-network permission. HTTP is never upgraded to HTTPS automatically.
settings.resetSectionDesc: Clear API configuration and custom prompts
settings.testing: Sending a fixed short text; post content is not included…
settings.testOk: Connected — the service returned valid content

toasts.invalidBudget: Input budget must be an integer 2000–48000 and output limit 256–8192

confirmReset:
Reset the configuration?
This clears the API configuration and custom prompts. History is kept.

history.storageHint: 💾 Stored locally in your browser only
history.confirmClear:
Clear all history?
This cannot be undone.
history.legacyRecord: Legacy record (site and range not stored)

viewer.title: Summary detail
viewer.chatHintWithDigest: Answers use the summary and attached digests; over budget, only the most recent complete exchanges are kept
viewer.chatHintPlain: Answers use the summary above; over budget, only the most recent complete exchanges are kept
viewer.budgetExceeded: Summary plus question exceeds the input budget. Raise the budget in settings or shorten the question.
